name: grok-skill
headline: grok-skill - Routes Twitter/X Prompts to Grok-4
short_description: The grok-skill is a Claude Code Skill that routes Twitter/X prompts to Grok-4 Live Search. It benefits operations teams by automating information retrieval from XAI's Grok-4 model. The skill connects to OpenRouter API and integrates with Claude agents to streamline data access and analysis workflows.
author: mikedemarais

sections.overview:
grok-skill is a Claude Code Skill that connects to xAI's Grok 4 model through OpenRouter, enabling real-time searches of X/Twitter data with Live Search enabled. The skill routes natural language queries to Grok 4 and returns summaries with tweet citations, filtered by handles, engagement metrics, and date ranges. Operations teams and analysts use grok-skill to automate information retrieval workflows, accessing trending topics, sentiment analysis, and breaking news directly from X without manual browsing. The skill includes network resilience with automatic retries, comprehensive filtering options, and production-ready error handling to ensure reliable data access at scale.
Monitor trending AI developments and industry announcements on X in real-time
Track crypto market sentiment and news from specific accounts with engagement filters
Automate competitive intelligence by searching for mentions of specific organizations
Gather real-time data for reports with date-bounded searches and citation tracking
sections.setup:
No install command available. Check the GitHub repository for manual installation instructions.
`git clone https://github.com/mikedemarais/grok-skill`
sections.usage:
```
I need to use the grok-skill to search for recent discussions about [TOPIC] on Twitter/X. Please route this prompt to Grok-4 Live Search via the OpenRouter API and provide a summary of the key findings. Focus on insights relevant to [COMPANY] in the [INDUSTRY] sector.
```
Copy

```
# Grok-4 Live Search Results for [TOPIC]
requirements: Claude Code or compatible AI agent
```
